title: How to Be a Good Friend
source_body:
Everyone wants good friends. But how can you be a good friend? Here are four tips.
First, listen carefully. When your friend talks, look at your friend and don't interrupt.
Second, share with your friends. You can share your snacks, books, or even your time. Sharing makes friends happy.
Third, keep secrets. If your friend tells you a secret, don't tell other people. Then your friend will trust you.
Finally, say sorry when you make a mistake. Everyone makes mistakes. Saying sorry is not easy, but it is very important. Also, forgive your friend when they say sorry to you.
A good friend is like a special present. If you are a good friend, you will have good friends, too!

variants.advanced:
Everyone wants good friends. But how can you become a good friend yourself? Here are four helpful tips.
First, listen carefully. When your friend is talking, look at your friend's face and try not to interrupt. This shows that you truly care about your friend's feelings.
Second, share with your friends. You can share your snacks, your books, or even your free time. Sharing makes your friends feel happy and special.
Third, keep secrets. If your friend tells you a secret, don't tell it to anyone else. Then your friend will know that you are trustworthy.
Finally, apologize when you make a mistake. Everyone makes mistakes sometimes. Saying sorry is not easy, but it is one of the most important things in a friendship. Also, be ready to forgive your friend when they say sorry to you.
A good friend is like a special present that you can keep forever. If you try to be a good friend, you will have good friends, too!
variants.prestudy:
Almost everyone hopes to have good friends, but not many people stop to think about what being a good friend actually requires. Here are four practical tips that anyone can follow.
First, be a careful listener. Whenever your friend is speaking, make eye contact and avoid interrupting, even if you are eager to share your own thoughts. Listening patiently shows your friend that their words truly matter to you.
Second, be generous with your friends. You might share your snacks or your favorite books, but the most valuable thing you can offer is your time. Sharing what you have makes your friends feel appreciated.
Third, keep the secrets that your friends trust you with. If a friend tells you something private, never pass it on to anyone else. Only a person who can keep a secret will be trusted completely.
Finally, apologize sincerely whenever you make a mistake. Nobody is perfect, and everyone makes mistakes from time to time. Although saying sorry is never easy, it is one of the most essential parts of any friendship. Likewise, be willing to forgive your friend when they apologize to you.
A true friend is like a precious gift that lasts a lifetime. If you make the effort to be a good friend, you will surely find good friends in return!
